title: Second verifier advancement label
statement: Let $N$ be a finite nondeterministic Turing machine with Boolean tape symbols, let $s$ be a verifier address state, and let $i$ be a natural number. If $i<2$, the label is the second advancement label for $s$, indexed by $i$; otherwise it is the test label for $s$.
hypotheses_covered: A finite nondeterministic Turing machine $N$ with Boolean tape symbols
